key_points: Rumors of AI chip acquisition (Tenstorrent) and Meta partnership could boost growth if materialized.
Reports of chip price hikes reflect rising supply costs, may pressure margins short term.
Huawei deal adds strategic AI expansion but limited immediate revenue impact.
Social media chatter and short‑term price swings are mostly noise.
Longer‑term thesis remains tied to AI data‑center demand and licensing revenue.
